properties.site-address: Land at Cornhill First School, St Helen's Gardens, Cornhill-on-Tweed (brownfield parcel)
properties.notes: Overall site comprises school buildings and associated land with the brownfield element representing around half of the overall site (0.41 ha). A yield of around 12 dwellings can be calculated based on methodological approach. For indicative purposes in the BF Register, the original SHLAA site (ref 6950) is split to reflect brownfield and greenfield elements - total area of 0.79 ha. An application for demolition of the school building and replacement with of 24 two- and three-bed dwellings was refused in October 2018 (17/03894/FUL). This proposal related to both the brownfield and greenfield areas of the site. However, this does not prevent a suitable scheme coming forward in the future following a revised proposal being deemed appropriate.
